Funnel Routing, Qualification Logic & Sales Scripts

Objective: Build a controlled client acquisition system that filters, qualifies, and converts leads using AI-driven routing, multi-tier ICP logic, and objection-handling scripts.

1. Funnel Routing Architecture

High-level Flow:

Lead Capture

Sources: Website forms, social media DMs, ad clicks, email campaigns.

Tools: HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier/n8n for automation.

AI: Neon Vision flags high-intent signals via behavioral scoring.

Qualification Layer

Tactical ICP: Single-service interest, small budget, 14–21 day pilot candidate.

Strategic ICP: Multi-service interest, scaling, ready for retainers.

Sovereign ICP: Enterprise, high spend, requires custom systems + dedicated AI engineers.

Tools: AI scoring engine with LLaMA-4 predictive analytics.

Auto-routing: CRM tags and triggers assign leads to correct tiered sales path.

Automated Pre-Qualification

Short AI-powered form evaluates:

Industry & niche fit
